meta.description: Synthetic, claims-data-style patient records reshaped from the same lat/lng geography used by backend/src/data/syntheticPopulation.ts. Every field except country/city/lat/lng anchor points is FABRICATED (deterministic seeded-random) — never real patient or claims data. Race is a detailed North-American mix for United States/Canada only; every other country gets a single regional descriptor, not a real census breakdown.
